properties.Name: The Pirate Inn
properties.food: I ordered a veg lasagna and they brought me a meat pie, they did change it. Breakfast not available
properties.room: Nice little pod this was the best bit, A little cold until I found a heater
properties.notes: I turned up late and they were doing pub bingo and the whole pub was playing, felt very out of place. I had to order food straight away, but got seated in a slightly quiter part of the bar. The accomodation was pods in the grounds of the pub so nice and quiet

properties.Name: The Mill House Inn
properties.food: I had a curry very nice and filling and Eaton mess for pud which I had never tried before but was absolutely delicious, breakfast was good too
properties.bike_storage: Outside sheltered inpub garden, but it waas an isolated place so it felt safe
properties.room: Decent room in old building up a lot of steps and windy coridoors
properties.notes: Friendly staff good food, we should have visited it before when we stayed in Trebarwith Strand

properties.Name: The Poltimore Inn
properties.food: I was so beat I ordered a meat quiche (lorraine) by mistate but eat it any way
properties.bike_storage: The bar lady said her father had run a bike shop so she understood bikes and let me keep it in my room, even carried it up the stairs for me
properties.notes: Very much a locals pub with people coming home from work for a drink, noisy till closing meant I couldn't sleep very well. Some confusion over whether I had paid already. Saw some walkers who were on a multi day trek

properties.Name: The Old Rectory
properties.food: Breakfast was OK in big glass conservatory. No evening meal had to go to campsite pub where I got an awfull pizza
properties.room: Nice little semi cottage, quiet, good sleep
properties.notes: Breen is an awfull holiday camp hell, this was the only old building in the place, on the other side of the dunes is a beautiful huge white sand beach thjat is inspoilt

properties.Name: Kilverts Inn
properties.food: Vegi buger was a bit squishy, breakfast OK
properties.room: Room fine in old historic buidling with lots of character
properties.notes: Met Andrew on this one, turned up at 7pm and was very tired

properties.Name: Ellesmere Hotel
properties.food: No food, went the Thai next door for supper, which was very good and spoke to some freindlt people, breakfast I found a nice local café, run by a sour faced cheshire type
properties.room: Room a very long way from bar, but that is a good thing
properties.notes: Histoic hotel that was a bit tired, no food, but they were having a karaoke competion

properties.Name: The Dressers Arms
properties.food: busy bar, got supper early was OK. No breakfast found chichi café near by with nice views over the valley - very cheshire
properties.bike_storage: Outside  in aprivate yard of pub
properties.notes: Busy country pub for Manchester and surounding areas not very friendly

properties.Name: The Brown Horse
properties.food: Oustanding, best veg meal ever? Vegetarian roast dinner - huge portion abd lovely pannecotta for desert. Brekfast good too
properties.room: Nice room in old inn, view overlooking countryside
properties.notes: I didn't get the warmest welcome as they were turning people away  (a bit snobb), but once they knew I had a room booked were much nicer - hosts daughter was living in Whistler

properties.Name: Holiday Inn
properties.food: Meal was nothing special, breakfast was buffet so I could really load up
properties.notes: Nice old building for meals but rooms in modern add on, very warm through the glass

properties.Name: Carlton
properties.food: No meal so I went to the restauraunt next doot very good but expensive golfer sort of place lovely views of beach and acreood the warter to Arran.Breakfast was a gong show I had arranged it for 8am so as to lweave by 8:30 to catch the ferry and the woman
properties.room: 50s décor, stunk of damp, only had vanilla flavoured coffee creamer
properties.notes: A very stinky house ran by an even stikier lady, could get out of there quick enough, slept in my clother with all the windows open just like the film Misery

properties.Name: Grey Gull
properties.food: Lorry driver café type food, it was curry night, so I got a curry not too bad. The breakfast was weird I swear the suasage was not vegtarian as it held together too well and I had some sort of empty pakora
properties.notes: They emailed me in the morning to say that theyhad a problem with the boiler and I could cancel if I wished.  I turned up any way to see if the boiler was fixed which it wasn't. I tried to book elsewhere, but all full so I had to take this place and have a sponge bath with water heated in the kettle. also do washing in sink with kettle water. on leaving I asked if there would be a discount for no water and was refused

properties.Name: Onich Hotel
properties.food: Nice supper and brekfast in diner overlooking the loch
properties.room: Small box room in staff quarters very noisy with staff coming in late after shift and starting very early for breakfast
properties.notes: Not much atmosphere about this place and a crappy room with single bed but at least it had hot water

properties.Name: Park Guest House
properties.food: breakfast OK but, it a bit small (no egg, I think they thought I was vegan). No evening meal, but walked in to town and got a noce middle eastern meal on recommendartion of host
properties.room: a bit clutterd and date, no ensuite shated bathroom OK, but peeing in the night a little awkward
properties.notes: more of a guest house, friendly cross table chatting a breakfast all US or Canadian visitors

properties.Name: Altnaharra Hotel
properties.food: Food OK, no vegatarian options on menu, but a vegi pasta was provided
properties.room: nice a bit of old luxury with a bath, but feeling a little tired
properties.notes: Run by a camp french dude that did everything a bit of a strange vibe

properties.Name: Seaview Hotel
properties.food: Food OK nothing to shout about
properties.bike_storage: In garage, but I was told I would have to share with 11 other cyclist that I never saw, somebody parked up right against the door and I was told they would be gone by 7am and they werent, but fortuenatetly I could get thrugh the other garage to retrieve m
properties.room: bunk house type room the tinest TV I have ever seen, fron door would not close  and blowing a gale, could only get luke warm water for a shower

properties.Name: North Link Ferries
properties.food: Great brekfast buffet in luxury lounge
properties.room: Lovely  bijoux cabin twin beds and a shower clean with porthole to watch the sea, could here the car alarms going off to start with but they shut up after about 30 min
properties.notes: After the long wait in the terminal this waas a touch of luxury. I didn't want to leave and they had emptied the car deck before I went to get my bike
